messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Cannot install camtrapR
parts:
Hi Viktor,
can you try installing with 

install.packages("camtrapR", dependencies=TRUE)

I don't believe this will be enough, as R seems to download the dependencies (and their respecive dependencies) but then fails to install them. 
I don't use Linux myself, so if it is Linux-specific I wouldn't know how to help here. Any Linux users here who might have encoutered that kind of problem before?

A few more thought and questions:
  • please share your sessionInfo()
  • Do you run into the same problem when you try to install other packages, or is it exclusive to camtrapR?
  • Do you use RStudio?
  • Please share the command you used and the complete R console output.
  • Do I see correctly that R tries to install the packes to your user library, not the system library? If it is the system library, try the user library instead. Limited user privileges may prevent installation in the system library.
  • Try installing the dependencies first, one by one. Do you get the same error messages?

I am sorry I can't be of any more immediate help here. 

Cheers,
Jürgen
